That’s exactly why I offer natural actor headshots outdoors, at your home, anywhere in England and Wales 📸✨

No long trek creasing your shirts in a bag. No artificial setup. Just clean, castable shots in a familiar environment 👌🏻

I've photographed over 2,950 actors. Many that return year-on-year as their headshots actually generate paid acting work.

Almost 3,000 actors can't be wrong ✨🎭

www.chriskeenanheadshots.com

Rola: za kamerą (dla chętnych: współtworzenie koncepcji reżyserskiej)

Projekt: teledysk artystyczny / eksperymentalny

Wynagrodzenie: zwrot kosztów dojazdu lub 130zł

Lokalizacja: Kraków 

Szukam osoby początkującej w branży filmowej, która chciałaby wesprzeć debiutujący duet muzyczny w realizacji teledysku. 

Teledysk będzie miał formę high-concept, opartą na symbolice i eksperymentach optycznych. Zależy nam na uzyskaniu efektów optycznych przede wszystkim podczas kręcenia, przez pracę z kamerą.

Jeśli kręcą Cię niestandardowe formy i masz ochotę współtworzyć niezależny projekt artystyczny, odezwij się!

* Typ: elegancki, dojrzały pan

* **Termin:** 23.10.2026 r.
* **Zakres:** 14:00 - 1:00
* **Lokalizacja:** Obiekt pod Warszawą (dojazd własny)

items.text:
🎥 CASTING DO GŁÓWNEJ ROLI DZIECIĘCEJ
Szukamy dziewczynki w wieku 7-12 lat do głównej roli w projekcie „30 Minut” realizowanym przez Studio Munka! 🎥

Kogo szukamy?

Dziewczynki z charakterem - naturalnej, trochę pyskatej, potrafiącej się obrazić i pokazać swoje niezadowolenie. Takiej, która ma w sobie dużo dziecięcej szczerości, a jednocześnie uważnie obserwuje świat i próbuje rozgryźć to, co dzieje się wokół niej.

Nie szukamy konkretnego typu urody ani aktorskiego doświadczenia - najważniejsza jest osobowość, naturalność i to coś, co przyciąga uwagę przed kamerą. Mile widziane niepełne uzębienie, szczególnie brakujące jedynki, ale nie jest to warunek konieczny.

📍 Miejsce castingu: Warszawa

📅 Termin: 27 października 2026 r.

Spośród zgłoszeń wybierzemy osoby, z którymi skontaktujemy się bezpośrednio i zaprosimy na casting.

Szukamy osób o etnicznej urodzie w wieku 5-17 lat do odgrywania scenek na nagrania/badania w Warszawie (Białołęka) w terminie 21.10-23.10.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Przedział godzinowy od 8:00 do 16:00. Dokładny termin i godziny do uzgodnienia.

2. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.

3. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Prosimy o podanie dat i przedział godzin dyspozycyjności?

8. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

STAFFING BOSTON CELTICS & BRUINS!!
Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking reliable, enthusiastic, and professional Brand Ambassadors to represent TD Bank at Boston Celtics and Boston Bruins home games at TD Garden in Boston, MA!

Event 1: Celtics

Friday, October 23, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Event 2: Bruins

Saturday, October 24, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Location:

TD Garden

100 Legends Way

Boston, MA 02114

Compensation:

Team Lead — $35 per hour

Brand Ambassadors — $30 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Parking:

Parking reimbursed with receipt.

Attire:

Branded t-shirts will be provided. Wear black pants (no leggings, sweatpants, or ripped/torn jeans) with clean, comfortable white sneakers. Long-sleeved black or white layers may be worn underneath the branded shirt, and black jackets are permitted as needed for colder weather.

Event Details: 

TD Bank is bringing game-day excitement to TD Garden for back-to-back home games featuring the Boston Celtics on Friday and the Boston Bruins on Saturday! Brand Ambassadors will be stationed throughout the exterior plaza and indoor concourse areas, engaging with fans, creating personalized player trading cards, and assisting with interactive games.

Team Lead Duties: 

• Must have experience leading large teams. 

• Oversee staff and coordinate team assignments. 

• Ensure smooth event execution and client communication. 

• Capture event photos and submit recaps.

Staff Duties:

• Assist with event prep, execution, and breakdown to ensure smooth operations.

• Engage with fans, communicate key brand messaging, and guide guests through the activation. 

• Maintain a fun, welcoming, and energetic atmosphere to create memorable fan experiences. 

• Support event activities, manage guest flow, and assist with giveaways.

Staff Expectations: 

We want high-energy, outgoing, and engaging Brand Ambassadors who know how to hype a crowd and create great vibes. You must be punctual, professional, and ready to bring it from start to finish!

Application Process:

To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:

• Availability

• Resume

• Headshot

• Relevant experience

• A brief description of why you're an excellent fit for this role.

Please use "TD Garden - Celtics & Bruins" as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.

🎬 **PAID CASTING CALL: Two leads for a narrative spec commercial (London, 14–15 Nov)**

**(repost now with day rates set)**

We're PickledFish, an emerging Edinburgh-based narrative production company. We're casting two leads for a stylised, Matrix-inspired narrative spec commercial. It's a self-funded spec project. It's fully practical, shot on the Alexa Mini LF in a professional London studio (Zone 2) with a full professional crew.

See our work: https://pickledfish.tv

After a big night out, Leo collapses on his couch and wakes in an endless white room. A mysterious suited figure offers him a choice: painkillers and a wasted day, or something better.

📅 Shoot: 14–15 Nov, London

—

LEO (lead, male, playing age 21–35)

💷 £50/day · 2 shoot days

Leo is a committed raver: still dancing when he's running on empty, then waking up bright, sharp and himself again. The role has no dialogue, so it's all physicality and expression. It goes from exhausted and spaced-out, to confused and wide-eyed in the white room, to warm, easy and laughing the next morning.

We're looking for someone who:

- is comfortable dancing on camera

- can tell a story with their body and face, without lines

- is available both days

—

SUITED FIGURE (lead, any gender, any ethnicity, playing age 30–65)

💷 £85/day · 1 shoot day

The Suited Figure is a calm, commanding and slightly unnerving guide who exists in "the moment just before you fall asleep." Think of a hypnotic mentor figure: measured, precise, a little theatrical, with total control of the room. They wear a dark suit, green tie and rimless glasses, which we provide. A homage to a certain iconic character.

We're looking for someone with:

- a strong voice and mesmerising delivery, since this role carries all of the dialogue

- stillness and presence on screen

- availability for one day, within 14–15 Nov (we'll confirm the date once you're cast)

—

💷 Paid day rates as above, plus food on set, travel covered, an IMDb-style credit and a high-quality copy of the finished film for your reel.

Usage: this is a spec commercial. It'll be used on PickledFish's portfolio, online channels and in festival submissions.

—

🎥 HOW TO APPLY

Email your self-tape link, headshot and CV to hello@pickledfish.tv with the role name in the subject line, by Wed 28 Oct. Applications by email only, please. We can't take submissions via DM or comments.

LEO: walk to a chair, slump into it exhausted and fall asleep. Then wake up, open your hand, and smile at what you find. A 10–20 second dance clip is a bonus.

SUITED FIGURE: record a self-tape of these sides:

"This... is the moment just before you fall asleep. You have a choice to make. Maybe your head hurts a little bit less, but you still wake up sluggish and dazed, stuck in bed as the day marches on. Remember, the choice is yours, yours, yours, yours, yours, yours..."

Thank you!

URGENT CASTING CALL for Production 2 of The Black Widows Pilot
3-day film shoot on the 15th-17th November 2026 in Coventry/Rugby

We have a micro budget so will provide lunch and cover travel expenses

 

Our current cast includes makeup-artists, director of photography, 1st assistant director and script supervisor alongside our cast of actors and actresses.

 

We have the main cast recruited but have some additional exciting roles available

 

We are searching for some talented actresses and actors to bring some of these compelling characters to life on our BLACK WIDOWS production. 

Set against a decade of betrayal, ambition, and bloody survival, Black Widows follows a fierce all-female crew operating in the shadows of a massive criminal empire.

The Character Profiles are below;

1. CEE (Late Teens/ Early Twenties) (2 scenes (1 day) This is an LGBT role

* Ethnicity & Look: Mixed Race, Latino or ethnically ambiguous 

* The Character: A gifted athlete and musician who plays Toya’s love interest. Cee possesses strong morals, fierce internal strength, and a rare, unyielding conscience forged by her unique background and upbringing. 

* Vibe: Captivating, athletic, soulful, and morally grounded amidst the chaos.

2. KIDADA’S FRIEND ALYSSA (Age Flexible / Adult) (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Slender White female with curly hair.

* The Character: A gritty, street-level drug addict who features briefly in the storyline. Desperate and unpredictable, she ultimately squats in Kidada’s home while Kidada is away in rehab. 

* Vibe: Raw, vulnerable, authentic, and emotionally charged.

3. VIVIAN (One scene – Half a day)

* Demographic: Black or Mixed-Race Woman, 50s to Early 60s.

* The Role: Vivian is a hardened, razor-sharp, and deeply complex woman. A recovering alcoholic, she holds the heaviest title in the room: she is the mother of Brenda James, the notorious, ruthless "mother of the underworld." 

* The Vibe: Vivian is hateful, resentful, brilliant, and fiercely intelligent. She is a multi-layered powerhouse who commands every single scene she is in. If you love playing complex, unapologetic characters with dark depths and sharp edges, Vivian is the role for you.

4. BEN (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 30s Male.

* The Character: A low level street runner who is a known criminal

5. MARCUS (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 40s-50s Male.

* The Character: A local unstable sleazeball who hustles and does whatever it takes to get on in life

6. Claire (One scene 2-3 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race (Age flexible female)

* The Character: A kind and friendly support worker who works at the drug and substance misuse clinic

EXTRA’s roles are available in addition to the above roles 

BENEFITS OF BEING PART OF THE PRODUCTION

* Official IMDb Credit: Boost your industry profile with a major television credit.

* CV & Acting Portfolio Development: Work alongside top-tier talent and crew, capturing stellar footage and high-end broadcast-quality material for your showreel post the production’s release.

* This production comes with a potential opportunity to reprise your role in a massive, upcoming 14-part TV series extension subject to investment funding! 

Please DM me for further details and to apply for the roles.

URGENT CASTING CALL for Production 2 of The Black Widows Pilot
3-day film shoot on the 15th-17th November 2026 in Coventry/Rugby

We have a micro budget so will provide lunch and cover travel expenses

 

Our current cast includes makeup-artists, director of photography, 1st assistant director and script supervisor alongside our cast of actors and actresses.

 

We have the main cast recruited but have some additional exciting roles available

 

We are searching for some talented actresses and actors to bring some of these compelling characters to life on our BLACK WIDOWS production. 

Set against a decade of betrayal, ambition, and bloody survival, Black Widows follows a fierce all-female crew operating in the shadows of a massive criminal empire.

The Character Profiles are below;

1. CEE (Late Teens/ Early Twenties) (2 scenes (1 day) This is an LGBT role

* Ethnicity & Look: Mixed Race, Latino or ethnically ambiguous 

* The Character: A gifted athlete and musician who plays Toya’s love interest. Cee possesses strong morals, fierce internal strength, and a rare, unyielding conscience forged by her unique background and upbringing. 

* Vibe: Captivating, athletic, soulful, and morally grounded amidst the chaos.

2. KIDADA’S FRIEND ALYSSA (Age Flexible / Adult) (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Slender White female with curly hair.

* The Character: A gritty, street-level drug addict who features briefly in the storyline. Desperate and unpredictable, she ultimately squats in Kidada’s home while Kidada is away in rehab. 

* Vibe: Raw, vulnerable, authentic, and emotionally charged.

3. VIVIAN (One scene – Half a day)

* Demographic: Black or Mixed-Race Woman, 50s to Early 60s.

* The Role: Vivian is a hardened, razor-sharp, and deeply complex woman. A recovering alcoholic, she holds the heaviest title in the room: she is the mother of Brenda James, the notorious, ruthless "mother of the underworld." 

* The Vibe: Vivian is hateful, resentful, brilliant, and fiercely intelligent. She is a multi-layered powerhouse who commands every single scene she is in. If you love playing complex, unapologetic characters with dark depths and sharp edges, Vivian is the role for you.

4. BEN (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 30s Male.

* The Character: A low level street runner who is a known criminal

5. MARCUS (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 40s-50s Male.

* The Character: A local unstable sleazeball who hustles and does whatever it takes to get on in life

6. Claire (One scene 2-3 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race (Age flexible female)

* The Character: A kind and friendly support worker who works at the drug and substance misuse clinic

CASTING – AKTORZY DO FILMU PROMOCYJNEGO NA ŚLĄSKU 

Poszukujemy doświadczonych aktorów do wcielenia się w postacie **różnych narodowości **w filmie promocyjnym realizowanym na Śląsku. Zależy nam na naturalnych, wiarygodnych osobach, swobodnie czujących się przed kamerą. 

🎭 Poszukiwane role:

**Rola 1: Amerykanin, rola niemówiona **

**Mężczyzna, 25–50 lat**
**Pochodzenie: **dowolne
**Typ: **brązowe lub ciemne włosy, mile widziany zarost
**Charakter**: otwarty, charyzmatyczny, naturalny

**Rola 2: Europejczyk, rola niemówiona**

**Mężczyzna, 25 - 50 lat**
**Pochodzenie: **dowolne
**Typ:** jasna karnacja, blond włosy 
**Charakter: **przyjazny, wiarygodny, naturalny
 
**Rola 3:  Japończyk, rola niemówiona **

**Mężczyzna, 25–50 lat**
**Pochodzenie: **japońskie
**Typ: **azjatycki (Japończyk), ciemne włosy 
**Charakter:** spokojny, sympatyczny, naturalny

🎬 CASTING – MAMA, TATA I CÓRKA | WARSZAWA
Cześć Warszawo! 🙂

Zapraszam do zgłoszeń do bardzo ciepłej, pięknej kampanii poruszającej ważny temat. Szukam 3 osób z umiejętnościami aktorskimi:

🔸 MAMA | 40–45 lat

Bystra, otwarta, chętna do wygłupów. O ciepłym głosie i łagodnym usposobieniu.

🔸 TATA | 45–50 lat

Sympatyczny mężczyzna z miłym uśmiechem. Mile widziany zarost.

🔸 CÓRKA | 15–18 lat

Z własnym gustem i sposobem bycia. Pochłonięta swoim światem, ale dobrze znająca rodziców i ich poczucie humoru.

💃 W scenariuszu są sceny tańca i wygłupów, dlatego do wszystkich ról zapraszam osoby, które dobrze się ruszają i czują swobodnie przed kamerą!

📅 TERMINY

• 27.10 – recall

• 3.11 – przymiarki

• 4.11 – zdjęcia

💰 STAWKI

• 1000 zł – dzień zdjęciowy + 20% prowizji

• 1000 zł – prawa + 20% prowizji

📍 Zapraszam głównie osoby z Warszawy i okolic. Produkcja nie zwraca kosztów podróży ani noclegów.

🎥 SELFTAPE

Na tym etapie prosimy jedynie o rozszerzoną wizytówkę – bez karty castingowej.

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA: plan@filmakcja.pl

W tytule maila wpisz rolę: MAMA, TATA lub CÓRKA.

W zgłoszeniu prześlij:

• imię i nazwisko,

• wiek,

• wyraźne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki,

• rozszerzoną wizytówkę wideo.

Zainteresowanym prześlę link do zgłoszenia castingowego.

⏰ Termin zgłoszeń: niedziela, 25.10, godz. 18:00.

Proszę o kompletne zgłoszenia – tylko takie będą brane pod uwagę.

Czekam na Was! 🙂

Marta Filmakcja 🎬

items.text:
Cześć! 🎬 Szukam możliwości udziału w produkcjach filmowych, serialach, teledyskach i reklamach-zarówno w charakterze statystki, jak i w rolach epizodycznych.
Mam za sobą modeling fotograficzny oraz udział w niszowych projektach artystycznych. Od około 10 lat związana jestem z tańcem brzucha, a poza tym pasjonuję się modą historyczną, strojami retro i estetyką dawnych epok. Mam również za sobą rok nauki śpiewu pod okiem instruktorki.
Interesują mnie szczególnie produkcje kostiumowe, historyczne, obyczajowe i artystyczne. Dobrze odnajduję się w różnych estetykach- od mrocznego, alternatywnego klimatu po elegancję vintage. Jestem otwarta na ciekawe propozycje i nowe doświadczenia przed kamerą. ✨

Zapraszam do kontaktu w wiadomości prywatnej! 🎞️

রেঙে উঠেছে মহানবমীর নিশি। জনপ্লাবিত কল্লোলিনী।

তারই মধ্যে সন্ধান চালাচ্ছি হটী বিদ্যালংকারের। ১৭ শতকের সেই বিদুষী বিদ্রোহিনীকে এই দেবীপক্ষে আবিষ্কার করতেই হবে।

আজ পৌঁছে গেছি অধ্যাপক, অভিনেতা শ্রীমতী সেঁজুতি 'হটী' মুখোপাধ্যায়ের চৌকাঠে। 

The night of Maha Navami is aglow. The bustling metropolis — Kallolini — is flooded with people.

And amidst it all, I am searching for HOTI VIDYALANKAR. That erudite, rebellious woman scholar of the 17th century must be discovered in this Devi Paksha.

Today, I have arrived at the doorstep of professor and actor, Smt. Senjuti 'HOTI' Mukhopadhyay.

Søges: Kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til at mime med kort musikvideo/ reel 🎬✨
I forbindelse med udgivelsen af mit debutalbum A Woman’s Heart i november, søger jeg kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til et et kort klip til en reel!

Hvad går det ud på?

Du skal blot filme en kort selfie-video (tæt på ansigtet), hvor du mimer med på omkvædet (musikken bliver lagt på bagefter) – enten med et stort smil, et fjollet udtryk eller bare ren god energi. Sangen handler nemlig om at slippe sig fri som kvinde, og omkvædet er supernemt at lære! 

Tanken er mange korte klip fra mange forskellige kvinder, så man ser dig højst sandsynligt kun i et par sekunder. ☺️

Det praktiske:

• Du filmer det selv derhjemme - burde ikke tage mere end 15 min. 

• Honorar: Der er et lille symbolsk honorar for din tid, da det også er en lille opgave og min økonomi ikke er så stor endnu. 

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så send mig en besked - så sender jeg sangen og mere info! ☺️

topComments.text: Helle Dahl det kan du også. 😊🤩

We especially need plus size, really slim, tall and a range of ages. Paid by bank transfer the next working day. Friendly team, relaxed studio.

***                                  Travel in the Magic of Lights***

***                                                       With***

***AEGON-LASER ***

AEGON-LASER is an innovative artist specializing in the use of laser technology to create spectacular light shows.

 

By combining high-precision lasers with stunning visual effects, AEGON-LASER transforms any event into a magical and immersive experience.

Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Been talking to some awesome people about a few roles in this show from my recent posts, and will be making final decisions fairly soon here! If you're interested in auditioning, or hearing more about any of the main or supporting roles, feel free to shoot us an email - thanks, all! 

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

**AMG ASSOCIATES**

**FILM • THEATRE • TELEVISION**

**LATEST AGENCY NEWS**

**BOOKS ARE NOW OPEN**

**AMG ASSOCIATES — FILM, THEATRE & TELEVISION AGENCY**

We are delighted to announce that AMG Associates is expanding, with our books now open to adult actors and comedians alongside growing our young performer books 

 

With over 17 years of experience running our established children’s agency, this marks an exciting new chapter for AMG Associates as we expand our roster to represent adult talent across film, television and theatre.

**A NOTE ABOUT OUR REBRAND**

Our full AMG Associates rebrand will launch in January, with further updates to our online presence and industry platforms at that time.

 

In the meantime, please don't be concerned if you are directed to our existing ACT2 website. This is our established children’s agency platform, which has been operating for over 17 years, and our new adult division is currently being developed as part of the rebrand.

 

As part of the January launch, we will also be listed with The PMA and will be using Tagmin for our represented actors.

**JOINING AMG ASSOCIATES**

There is:

• No joining fee

• No audition

• No upfront representation fee

 

To be considered, we ask that applicants:

• Are already a Spotlight member

• Have a professional showreel available

• Provide a current professional headshot

• Have appropriate professional experience and/or training

 

At this stage, we are not accepting submissions from models or supporting artists (SAs), and we are not currently taking on below-the-line creatives.

**APPLICATION TIMELINE**

Submission deadline: 30 November

Shortlisting: 15 December

 

Successful shortlisted applicants will then be invited to interviews in the New Year, ahead of the January rebrand and launch.

 

We are looking for exciting, professional and committed talent to join us as we enter this next chapter.

**CONTACT**

AMG ASSOCIATES

Film • Theatre • Television

info@amgassociates.co.uk

 

ACT2 website: www.act2drama.co.uk

Spotlight: www.spotlight.com

 

BOOKS ARE OPEN — APPLY NOW

At this stage, we are not accepting submissions from models or supporting artists (SAs), and we are not currently taking on below-the-line creatives.

Successful shortlisted applicants will then be invited to interviews in the New Year, ahead of the January rebrand and launch.

 

We are looking for exciting, professional and committed talent to join us as we enter this next chapter.

info@amgassociates.co.uk

Spotlight: www.spotlight.com

LADbible Castings:

1. Looking for genuine students who are currently studying at any University in Oxford for a fun shoot where you'll answer quiz questions about science to try and win free Dominos pizza. 29th of October in Oxford, £250 payment.
2. Looking for people with the surname Little, Littler or any variation of the 'Little' name for a wholesome Christmas campaign. Shooting in London on 19th November. £300 payment.
3. Looking for someone to nominate a community hero (could be a fireperson, frontline worker, someone very deserving) for a wholesome surprise shoot. Shooting in London on 30th November. £500 payment per person involved.
4. Looking for a someone who has a partner who does shift work and usually works a lot over the Christmas period to nominate them for a lovely surprise. Would be better if the family also has children so the group can be involved. Shooting 12th November, can be flexible on location. £300 payment for each person involved
5. Looking for a hilarious granny or grandad with a natural comedy flair who can film with their grown up grandkids and surprise them with some 'Gen Alpha' slang. Shooting in London on 26th November. £2000 payment for whole family.

If interested in any of these castings please drop me an email to erica.stein@ladbiblegroup.com letting me know which one and I will forward more information. Thanks!

Poszukujemy Statystów w wieku 18-70 lat (kobiety i mężczyzn) z Kielc lub okolic na plan zdjęciowy do spotu reklamowego dla znanej sieci restauracji w Kielcach w dniach 3.11, lub 4.11 (wtorek lub środa).

1. Zdjęcia w plenerze. Nagrania późnym popołudniem do nocy.

2. Wynagrodzenie za 1 dzień zdjęciowy: 150 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po planie zdjęciowym — BLIK na numer telefonu/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania i dostępności w dniach 3.11 lub 4.11 prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy

5. Adres e-mail

6. Wzrost

7. Czy jest Pan/Pani dostępna/y w terminie 3.11-4.11?

8. Link do swojego profilu na Facebook/Instagram

9. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Plan zdjęciowy Kielce

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w planie zdjęciowym zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

**AMG ASSOCIATES**

**FILM • THEATRE • TELEVISION**

**LATEST AGENCY NEWS**

**BOOKS ARE NOW OPEN**

**AMG ASSOCIATES — FILM, THEATRE & TELEVISION AGENCY**

We are delighted to announce that AMG Associates is expanding, with our books now open to adult actors and comedians alongside growing our young performer books 

 

With over 17 years of experience running our established children’s agency, this marks an exciting new chapter for AMG Associates as we expand our roster to represent adult talent across film, television and theatre.

**A NOTE ABOUT OUR REBRAND**

Our full AMG Associates rebrand will launch in January, with further updates to our online presence and industry platforms at that time.

 

In the meantime, please don't be concerned if you are directed to our existing ACT2 website. This is our established children’s agency platform, which has been operating for over 17 years, and our new adult division is currently being developed as part of the rebrand.

 

As part of the January launch, we will also be listed with The PMA and will be using Tagmin for our represented actors.

**JOINING AMG ASSOCIATES**

There is:

• No joining fee

• No audition

• No upfront representation fee

 

To be considered, we ask that applicants:

• Are already a Spotlight member

• Have a professional showreel available

• Provide a current professional headshot

• Have appropriate professional experience and/or training

 

At this stage, we are not accepting submissions from models or supporting artists (SAs), and we are not currently taking on below-the-line creatives.

**APPLICATION TIMELINE**

Submission deadline: 30 November

Shortlisting: 15 December

 

Successful shortlisted applicants will then be invited to interviews in the New Year, ahead of the January rebrand and launch.

 

We are looking for exciting, professional and committed talent to join us as we enter this next chapter.

**CONTACT**

AMG ASSOCIATES

Film • Theatre • Television

info@amgassociates.co.uk

 

ACT2 website: www.act2drama.co.uk

Spotlight: www.spotlight.com

 

BOOKS ARE OPEN — APPLY NOW

Hi everyone! We are casting for a lifestyle promo video and street interview shoot for a dating app in the SF Bay Area. We are currently looking for:

Non-Union | Unpaid | No Previous Experience Required

Hello everyone! My name is Jamison Horne. I am a film student at Depaul University and My friends and I are filming a music video for an up-and-coming artist, and we’d love for you to be part of it! We’re looking for about 30 faces to help fill out a crowd scene.

📅 When: Monday, November 2, 2026

⏰ Call Time: 12:00 PM 

📍 Where: Downtown Chicago (exact address sent once you’re confirmed)

✨ Who we’re looking for:

Everyone! All backgrounds, styles, and personalities (18+). No previous experience required. Just bring good energy. If you’ve got the day off, come spend it with us on set!

👕 What to wear: ALL GREY

Any shade, any style: hoodies, sweats, coats, whatever you love. November in Chicago gets chilly, so please bundle up!

💛 What we’re offering:

🍕 Food and snacks to keep you fueled all day

🎥 A spot in the final music video

🎬 A fun, behind-the-scenes look at a real production

A few things to know:

This is a non-union, unpaid, zero-budget passion project, so we’re not able to cover transportation, parking, or other costs. Please plan your own way to and from set. 

If you would like to be composited into a 3D world for free, and for experience purposes, feel welcomed to join. 

🙌 Want to join us?

Fill out the form below if you’re available on Nov 2. Friends are welcome too, just send them this form and bring them along!

We can’t wait to create something amazing together. Please share with anyone who might be interested! 💫

ER DU GOD TIL AT LYVE? VI SØGER FRIVILLIGE DELTAGERE TIL EN YOUTUBE-VIDEO I MORGEN! (
Er du god til at lyve, fortælle historier og tage lidt pis på andre? Så søger vi dig!

Vi er Chris & Jacob, og vi mangler 3 personer (18+) til en sjov YouTube-video, vi optager i morgen!

Konceptet:

Vi samler 5 deltagere, som hver især har én vild, sjov eller usædvanlig historie fra deres liv.

Vi skal igennem 5 runder, hvor alle deltagere fortæller deres version af den samme historie. Men kun én fortæller sandheden, mens de andre 4 skal forsøge at lyve sig igennem!

Vores opgave er at afhøre jer og finde ud af, hvem der faktisk har oplevet historien.

Du behøver ikke være skuespiller eller verdensmester i at lyve! I får historiernes overskrifter på forhånd, så I kan forberede jer.

Vi søger bare nogle friske, udadvendte personer med god humor, som har lyst til at være med på kamera!

Praktisk info:

Søndag den 18. oktober kl. 15.00-18.00( konservativt sat, nok kortere)

Amager, København

18+

Det er frivillig og ulønnet deltagelse.

VIL DU VÆRE MED?

Send en SMS til  Mandarina på 31 49 55 65 med:

* Dit navn og alder
* En kort beskrivelse af en vild, sjov, pinlig eller usædvanlig sand historie fra dit liv

Vi mangler kun 3 deltagere, så skriv meget gerne allerede i dag!

🎬 KRAKÓW POSZUKUJEMY KOSTIUMOGRAFA/FKI DO FILMU DYPLOMOWEGO  

 

Do realizacji filmu krótkometrażowego, dyplomowego poszukujemy osoby, która podejmie się współtworzenia wizualnej strony naszej produkcji. Zdjęcia są zaplanowane na przełom listopada i grudnia.

 

Szukamy osoby z wyczuciem estetycznym, kreatywnością i umiejętnością opowiadania historii poprzez kostium. Zależy nam na współpracy przy tworzeniu koncepcji kostiumograficznej dopasowanej do świata przedstawionego, postaci i atmosfery filmu.

 

Oczekujemy kreatywnego podejścia i zaangażowania.

Mile widziane doświadczenie przy produkcjach filmowych lub teatralnych.

 

Oferujemy możliwość współtworzenia niezależnego projektu filmowego, rozwijania własnych pomysłów i współpracy z ekipą filmową.

 

📩 Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o przesłanie krótkiego portfolio lub informacji o dotychczasowych realizacjach oraz kilku słów o sobie na adres: **marzena.casting@gmail.com**

 

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: „Kostiumograf – dyplom”.

CASTING CALL!!!
FOULMOUTH Theatre is looking for two performers for an upcoming production that we’ll be announcing VERY soon. For now we’re keeping our mouths shut. Uncharacteristic we know 😉

We’re looking for:

🎤 FEMALE PERFORMER

Youthful appearance, comfortable singing. No formal singing experience necessary!

🎸 MALE PERFORMER

Youthful appearance, actor-musician. Let us know what instrument(s) you play and your level of experience!

Northern accents are particularly encouraged and both performers must be aged 18 or over.

This is a profit-share production with travel expenses covered and applicants must have good availability during the last week of November and first week of December 2026.

To register your interest, email info@foulmouth.uk with the subject line: YOUR NAME // ACTOR CALL OUT

Please include your name, location, recent headshot and Spotlight link or acting CV. Actor-musicians should also include their instrument(s) and playing level.

⏰ DEADLINE: FRIDAY 23RD OCTOBER

We’ll be in touch with further casting information and audition details!

BIG LOVE,

FOULMOUTH x

Actors!!! For the first time since 2021 - I’m getting back into the acting class room with my company on Mondays to work with both aspiring and working actors in this 8-Week Acting for the Camera Lab at Heritage College. 7:30-10:30pm

We will be workshopping new material in development, practicing auditions on camera aka self-tape magic, filming and reviewing with constructive feedback, the business of acting from the audition all the way to the red carpet, the power of creating your own work, being your best and truest self, confident on camera and working with fear, joy, love, sadness, frustration - whatever the story and the character calls for. You will have a blast identifying the little tricks that make your acting go from fake and unmoving to stunning, real and captivating! Spaces are limited. Please dm for details and to reserve your spot. ✨🎬❤️😌🎥

Actors!!! For the first time since 2021 - I’m getting back into the acting class room with my company on Mondays to work with both aspiring and working actors in this 8-Week Acting for the Camera Lab at Heritage College. 7:30-10:30pm

We will be workshopping new material in development, practicing auditions on camera aka self-tape magic, filming and reviewing with constructive feedback, the business of acting from the audition all the way to the red carpet, the power of creating your own work, being your best and truest self, confident on camera and working with fear, joy, love, sadness, frustration - whatever the story and the character calls for. You will have a blast identifying the little tricks that make your acting go from fake and unmoving to stunning, real and captivating! Spaces are limited. Please dm for details and to reserve your spot. ✨🎬❤️😌🎥

#actingcoach #screentraining #claudiajurt #joshuaodjick #acting

🎭 THERE’S STILL ROOM FOR YOU IN THE CRUCIBLE! ❤️

Come be part of something meaningful!
Our auditions are almost full, but there are still so many ways to get involved in our exciting community theatre production of The Crucible, coming to Ottawa’s Gladstone Theatre in February 2027!
Whether you’ve never set foot in a theatre or have years of professional experience, we’d love to hear from you!
No experience necessary! And to those with experience, knowledge, and expertise to share, your volunteer contributions would be enormously valued.
We also believe this experience has something wonderful to offer everyone who participates.

❤️ MORE THAN A PLAY
Arthur Miller wrote The Crucible in 1953 as a parable for McCarthyism and the fear, accusations, and political persecution of his time.
We believe it can also serve as a powerful parable for the times we’re living in today.
Through this production, we’ll explore questions about fear, power, conformity, courage, conscience, and what happens when communities turn against one another.
We’re not here to tell people what to think. We’re creating space to think, question, discuss, and explore together.
And, of course, to create some wonderful theatre along the way!

🌟 HOW CAN YOU GET INVOLVED?
🎭 Onstage: Non-speaking roles, ensemble performers, and understudies.

🎨 Creative & Technical: Sets, props, costumes, construction, painting, hair and makeup, lighting, sound, and backstage crew.

🎬 Production Support: Stage management, rehearsal assistance, volunteer coordination, transportation, logistics, photography, and video.

📣 Marketing & Community: Social media, postering, publicity, creating our online program, finding sponsors, connecting with local TV, radio, newspapers and podcasts, and community outreach.

❤️ Special Opportunities: Helping organize our intergenerational performance for seniors and high school students, supporting special lobby activities, accessibility and participant support, and other helping hands!

Have a talent or idea we haven’t mentioned? Tell us!

📅 COME MEET US!
Tuesday, October 20 at 6:00 p.m.

📍 All Saints Westboro
347 Richmond Road, Ottawa
This is an opportunity for people interested in non-speaking roles and behind-the-scenes involvement to meet us and learn more about the production.

Please email us in advance to let us know you’re coming. No drop-ins, please!

💌 connect@nataliefraser.ca
Include your name, phone number, areas of interest, any experience or skills you’d like to share, your general availability, and whether you’ll attend October 20.

Can’t make October 20? That’s absolutely fine! Email us anyway, and we’ll invite you to join us on November 1.
🗓️ WHAT ABOUT THE COMMITMENT?
Rehearsals will generally take place on Wednesdays and Sundays, but not everyone will be needed every week. There will also be some full-cast and crew days, with details shared as we develop the rehearsal schedule.

❤️ WHY BE PART OF IT?
Because community theatre is about more than putting on a show.
It’s about people of different ages, backgrounds, and experiences coming together. Sharing skills. Learning new things. Building friendships. Challenging ourselves. Having fun. And creating something that matters.
Whether you come to learn, to share your expertise, to meet new people, or because the themes of this play speak to you, we hope you’ll find something meaningful in the experience too.
The Crucible was a parable for Miller’s time. What might it reveal about ours?
Let’s explore that together!

🎭 THE CRUCIBLE
February 17–20, 2027
The Gladstone Theatre, Ottawa
Unedited Woman Productions
Come for the theatre. Stay for the community. Be part of the conversation. ❤️

#TheCrucible #OttawaTheatre #CommunityTheatre #OttawaVolunteers #UneditedWomanProductions #TheGladstone #VolunteerOttawa

Mon 18th to Sat 23rd Jan 27 | 9am to 5pm

**JOHNSON PARANORMAL**

**Casting Call**

**Casting Director **– C. Patricio 

**Producers **– Ian David Nsenga, Maritama Carlson, Jeff Schellenberg

**Director **– Jeff Schellenberg

**Shoot Dates** - Nov. 19-22, 2026

**Compensation **- $200/Day

**Filming Locations** – New Westminster & Maple Ridge, B.C.

**Union Status **- Open to UBCP Union and Non-Union Performers

 

**Synopsis **– An edgy, laugh-out-loud, horror-comedy web-series about three half-brothers who open a ghost hunting start-up out of their aunt’s garage. Each episode brings a procedural-esque investigation as the crew tackles a wild new supernatural mystery.

**Tone**: Ghostbusters meets Always Sunny in Philadelphia. 

 

**CHARACTERS**

 

**FRED**** **Lead (30s/male) Fred is effortlessly handsome, incredibly chill, and a natural social butterfly. He possesses a genius-level EQ, making him instantly likable and a massive hit with the ladies—though his disorganization and inability to say no to a good time recently backfired, leaving him an ex-girlfriend turned nightmare stalker.

Brilliant, adaptable, and a victim of vanity, Fred holds a degree in chemical engineering. However, after AI took his corporate job, he decided to pivot to his childhood dream of launching his own ghost exterminating business. This unconventional career move finally allows him to monetize a deep, lifelong passion for the paranormal.

[Skills: Superb comedic timing. Strong improvisation skills are a major asset. Fred needs to feel grounded, quick on his feet, and effortlessly witty. Open to any ethnicity.]

 

**KENNY**** **Lead (30/male) Kenny is a laid-back, jack-of-all-trades with a brilliant mechanical mind and endless blue-collar connections. He’s a fisherman by trade, but with the local fishing market collapsing, he’s had to pivot to a brand-new venture: ghost exterminating.

Kenny loves a cold beer (frequently enjoyed on the job), finding clever workarounds to hard labor (which others might call laziness), and pulling a good prank. He’s a natural mentor to Delmer, but often clashes with Justin’s academic methods. He’s comfortable in his own skin, rough around the edges, and fiercely loyal.

[Skills: Excellent Physical Comedy & Distinct Character Work: We need an actor who can bring a strong, specific physical presence and comedic timing to the screen. Strong improv skills are a major asset to capture his quick-witted, easygoing banter. A natural beer belly or a burly, blue-collar physique is a huge plus. Open to any ethnicity.] 

 

**JUSTIN**** **Lead (30s/male) A brilliant but tightly wound IT whiz who walked away from tech to chase a childhood dream with his two half-brothers of opening a ghost-hunting startup. With a math PhD and software background, Justin is a true polymath, a Shakespeare nut, and a sarcastic history buff who treats life as a quest to expand his brainpower. What he has in academic genius, he completely lacks in street smarts. He’s thrilled to finally be his own boss (sort of) and step into a new chapter of personal freedom. 

[Skills: Comedic delivery. Ability to improvise is an asset. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**DELMER**** **Co-Lead (18/male) Delmer is a friendly, sweet, genuine, and wide-eyed Hutterite runaway standing on the edge of a massive new world. Built with a solid, farm-raised physicality but carrying a deep, untouched innocence, he has spent his entire life in a strict communal society. Now, he is chasing a burning yearning to experience everything he’s never seen: skyscrapers piercing the clouds, bustling shopping malls, roaring sports cars, helicopters, the vast ocean and the electric pulse of big-city nightclubs.

This role is a powerhouse opportunity for an actor to portray a profound coming-of-age journey. We are looking for someone who can beautifully balance a strong physical presence with an endearing, vulnerable naivety as Delmer steps into his chaotic, exciting next chapter. [Actor must be 18+. Preference for Caucasian ethnicity]

 

**LILY**** **Co-Lead (30/female) Lily is cute, witty, and fiercely independent. After walking away from a cushy corporate ladder and a highly judgmental family, she traded her high heels for work boots to chase her dream: running her own hobby farm.

She’s earnest, deeply down-to-earth, and entirely back-to-nature—but passion doesn't pay the tuition for her agricultural courses. Enter Johnson Paranormal. To fund her late-night studying, she’s taken a gig as the agency's newest secretary. Balancing spreadsheets, ghost sightings, and goat feed, Lily is a grounded force in a chaotic, supernatural world. [Preference for Chinese/East Asian ethnicity]

 

**Ms. GUNDERSON** (80/female) She’s your friendly neighborhood grandma. She’s sweet, independent, slightly oblivious, devoted to her baking and prized cactus, and isn't afraid to unwind with a THC gummy. But her cozy world is turned upside down by an overwhelming ghost presence that's taking over her home.

[We are looking for an actress who can balance warmth and genuine vulnerability, as she faces the supernatural and keeps an embarrassing secret. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**TONY**** **(40s/male) Tony is the ultimate contradiction: a chill, uber-organized, and ruthlessly violent drug importer who genuinely believes in giving back to his community. When he isn't managing high-stakes international logistics or handling business with cold precision, he’s passionately funding local charities and cheering on neighborhood sports teams. He runs his empire like a Fortune 500 company, but his meticulously ordered life has just been thrown into complete chaos.

An annoying, chaotic ghost has moved into his estate, wreaking absolute havoc on his sanity and his bottom line. Tony is a man used to eliminating his problems—but how do you eliminate something you can’t kill?

[Seeking an actor who can balance a grounded, dangerous intensity with a relaxed, dry charm. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**How to Apply**

Please submit your headshot, resume, and demo reel (if available) to:
**Johnsonparanormalshow@gmail.com**

*Please include the character name you are submitting for in the email subject line (e.g., "Submission: FRED - [Your Name]").*

**CASTING CALL – LA MORSURE**

Hi! We’re currently pre-casting for **LA MORSURE**, a French-language psychological horror web series for TV5+, filming in Vancouver in April 2027.

We’re looking for fluent French-speaking actors! We’re currently casting three specific roles, but we welcome submissions from all interested French-speaking actors, regardless of whether they fit the profiles listed in the casting breakdown, as additional supporting roles will be cast soon. 

**Paid - Open to both Union and Non union actors**

**Character descriptions & casting call:**
[[https://www.castingworkbook.com/open-breakdown/0176646](https://www.castingworkbook.com/open-breakdown/0176646)](https://www.castingworkbook.com/open-breakdown/0176646)

Please **submit by October 30** with your demo reel and a short self-introduction video in French via Casting Workbook, or through our submission form if you don’t have a Casting Workbook account: [[https://forms.gle/nR47YRtnpZvidMkT7](https://forms.gle/nR47YRtnpZvidMkT7)](https://forms.gle/nR47YRtnpZvidMkT7)

Do pierwszego odcinka 2. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

1.Iwona (41) – kobieta po stracie dziecka, załamana, rozbita, wrak człowieka. Chorobliwie szczupła i zniszczona problemami.  
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 700 zł netto

2. Miłosz (46) – adopcyjny ojciec, przeciętny facet zniszczony życiem, w depresji.  
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

3.Przechodzień (41) – konkretny, rzeczowy  
Data: 26.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

topComments.text: If this company uses AI slop for their posters, how badly are they going to treat their other artists?

Please don't use #AIslop for casting calls. 🙁
AI is MURDERING HUMAN BEINGS. If that's not reason enough to stop using it, I don't know what is. 💔
#AIslop should not be used by Casting professionals and other industry pros, to officially communicate with actors, either as casting calls, promo posts, advertisements or other messages.
The simple facts that AI was founded on the STOLEN work of actors and other artists; and has become such a volatile disruptor of our entire industry, causing the loss of jobs, the cheapening of our art form, not to mention the very real destruction of our environment, which MOST artists care deeply about...
That alone should be enough for the pros to acknowledge and be sensitive to the fact that using the technology is disrespectful to the actors they work with.

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania

CASTING CALL — AM I BEAUTIFUL?
Independent Supernatural Horror Feature

Some questions should never be answered.

When an antique mirror connects a university classroom to a disturbing Japanese legend, a cultural anthropology professor searches for answers as people around her begin dying.

ROLES AVAILABLE
Ages listed are playing ages.

MAYA BENNETT — Woman, 35–45
An intelligent, compassionate anthropology professor whose determination to protect her students becomes an obsession.

AIKO MORITA / THE WOMAN — Japanese woman, 28–40
A tragic woman behind a terrifying supernatural presence. Requires emotional range, expressive eyes, and strong physical storytelling. Prosthetic makeup and choreographed violence involved.

LENA ORTIZ — Woman, 20–25
A perceptive, outspoken student whose confidence is tested by grief and escalating supernatural encounters.

EMI SATO — Japanese woman, 35–50
A warm, practical language lecturer and Maya’s close friend. Dryly funny and fiercely dependable.

NICOLE BENNETT — Woman, 38–48
Maya’s loving, direct sister, struggling to keep her connected to her family.

OWEN PRICE — Man, 20–25
A charming, sarcastic student whose ordinary night becomes a terrifying fight for survival.

MARCUS REED — Man, 21–26
Owen’s easygoing close friend. Requires humor, emotional vulnerability, and intense fear.

TESSA — Woman, 20–25
A curious student who shares fragments of a disturbing legend before its consequences become personal.

DANIEL HART — Man, 40–50
A meticulous, quietly humorous university collections manager. Includes a sustained physical horror sequence.

LUIS VEGA — Man, 45–60
An experienced campus security officer with dry humor and a strong protective instinct.

NOAH WELLS — Man, 21–27
A student and campus employee caught in a terrifying encounter after his shift. Requires physical suspense and simulated injury effects.

CALEB TURNER — Man, 20–26
A student working at the recreation center whose closing routine becomes a fight for survival.

KENJI — Japanese man, 30–45
Aiko’s jealous, controlling husband. Requires restrained menace and choreographed dramatic violence.

YUMI — Japanese woman, 23–33
Aiko’s affectionate younger sister. Requires warmth, underlying concern, and a powerful grief reaction.

NAOKO — Japanese woman, 60–75
A dignified, direct woman determined to protect the truth about her family’s history.

DETECTIVE ALVAREZ — Man, 35–55
A calm, compassionate investigator who remains skeptical of extraordinary explanations.

DEPARTMENT CHAIR — Woman, 45–65
An authoritative university administrator balancing professional responsibilities with concern for her colleagues and students.

JESS — Woman, 20–25
Lena’s caring, practical roommate. Requires natural dialogue and believable friendship chemistry.

PRODUCTION DETAILS

Location: TBD — Houston, TX or Atlanta, GA
Projected filming: Spring 2027
Non-union
Lead roles: $400/day
Supporting roles: $300/day
Submission deadline: December 1, 2026

Seeking a diverse cast. All performers must be 18 or older. Roles without a specified ethnicity are open to all ethnicities.

Japanese-speaking ability is a plus, but NOT a requirement. Select roles include Japanese dialogue.

This film includes supernatural horror, simulated blood, prosthetic makeup, and choreographed violence. Certain roles involve domestic violence and suicide themes. Role-specific requirements will be discussed during casting.

TO SUBMIT

Email amibeautiful2027@gmail.com with:

• Name and role(s) of interest
• Current headshot
• Acting résumé or experience summary
• Reel or acting sample, if available
• Home city and spring 2027 availability
• Ability to work in Houston, Atlanta, or either location
• Japanese-language proficiency, if applicable

Share with an actor who would be a great fit!

MEN WANTED FOR A COPENHAGEN MUSIC FILM 🎬
I’m looking for a group of men to join two striking scenes in an ambitious, fashion-forward music film: a surreal clinic scene and a dark-red, burlesque-inspired orgy tableau.

No dance experience or special skills needed—just be open to trying some simple, choreographed movement and bringing your presence. The scenes will be carefully staged, with movement and boundaries discussed together in advance.

Filming in Copenhagen, 16–17 November. Interested? DM me and I’ll send you the details ❤️

🚢 CASTING | CRUISE SHIP CONTRACT 💃✨
We are looking for a professional Female Dancer for an upcoming cruise ship contract!

📅 Contract Period:

Rehearsals:
April 3, 2027 – May 16, 2027

1️⃣ First Contract:
May 16, 2027 – October 18, 2027

🌴 Scheduled Break:
Approximately 1 month

2️⃣ Second Contract:
November 17, 2027 – June 20, 2028

📌 Please note: The engagement consists of two contracts with a scheduled break in between. Exact contract and break dates are subject to confirmation.

✨ Requirements:
•Excellent dance technique in Jazz, Modern, •Contemporary, Ballet & Show Dance
•Strong partnering skills
•Previous cruise ship experience is MANDATORY
•Professional stage experience
•Chorus singing skills are a plus
•Ability to work in an international cast

⚠️ IMPORTANT:
Due to the length of the engagement, ONLY female dancers with previous cruise ship experience will be considered.

📩 How to apply:
Please send your application ONLY by email to:
📧 kopentertainmentagency@gmail.com

❗️ Email must include:
1️⃣ Updated CV (PDF) with portrait photo
2️⃣ Height & weight
3️⃣ Professional dance showreel link (YouTube or Vimeo)
4️⃣ Voice demo (if available)

📲 WANT MORE CASTING OPPORTUNITIES?

Join our official Telegram group for more information, upcoming auditions, cruise ship contracts and international job opportunities for performers! 🌍

👉 https://t.me/kopentertainmentagency

✨ If this opportunity is not for you, please share it with other professional female dancers who might be interested! 🙏

See you on board! 🚢✨

🎬 CZEŚĆ WARSZAWO! SZUKAM IMPREZOWICZÓW! 🎉
Na plan reklamy jednej z platform sprzedażowych szukam statystów w wieku 17–25 lat do roli imprezowiczów.

Osoby powyżej 20. roku życia muszą wyglądać na maksymalnie 20 lat.

📅 Zdjęcia: 25.10 lub 26.10

To nie jest kontynuacja — w zgłoszeniu podajcie datę lub obie daty, w których jesteście dostępni.

⏰ Godziny nie są jeszcze znane, a plan może rozpocząć się wcześnie rano. Wymagana pełna dyspozycyjność w zgłaszanym dniu.

💰 Stawka: 140 zł, płatne przelewem.

W przypadku wykorzystania wizerunku przewidziana jest dopłata.

📲 Zgłoszenia wysyłajcie na numer: 797 169 069

Z dopiskiem „IMPREZOWICZ + data”.

W zgłoszeniu proszę zawrzeć:

• imię i nazwisko,

• wiek,

• wyraźne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki.

❗ Pod uwagę będą brane tylko kompletne zgłoszenia.

📩 Na zgłoszenia czekam do 22.10 do godz. 19:00.

Do wybranych osób odezwę się do końca dnia 23.10.

Marta 🎬 Filmakcja

Dobrego dnia! 😀

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

**AMG ASSOCIATES**

**FILM • THEATRE • TELEVISION**

**LATEST AGENCY NEWS**

**BOOKS ARE NOW OPEN**

**AMG ASSOCIATES — FILM, THEATRE & TELEVISION AGENCY**

We are delighted to announce that AMG Associates is expanding, with our books now open to adult actors and comedians alongside growing our young performer books 

 

With over 17 years of experience running our established children’s agency, this marks an exciting new chapter for AMG Associates as we expand our roster to represent adult talent across film, television and theatre.

**A NOTE ABOUT OUR REBRAND**

Our full AMG Associates rebrand will launch in January, with further updates to our online presence and industry platforms at that time.

 

In the meantime, please don't be concerned if you are directed to our existing ACT2 website. This is our established children’s agency platform, which has been operating for over 17 years, and our new adult division is currently being developed as part of the rebrand.

 

As part of the January launch, we will also be listed with The PMA and will be using Tagmin for our represented actors.

**JOINING AMG ASSOCIATES**

There is:

• No joining fee

• No audition

• No upfront representation fee

 

To be considered, we ask that applicants:

• Are already a Spotlight member

• Have a professional showreel available

• Provide a current professional headshot

• Have appropriate professional experience and/or training

 

At this stage, we are not accepting submissions from models or supporting artists (SAs), and we are not currently taking on below-the-line creatives.

**APPLICATION TIMELINE**

Submission deadline: 30 November

Shortlisting: 15 December

 

Successful shortlisted applicants will then be invited to interviews in the New Year, ahead of the January rebrand and launch.

 

We are looking for exciting, professional and committed talent to join us as we enter this next chapter.

**CONTACT**

AMG ASSOCIATES

Film • Theatre • Television

info@amgassociates.co.uk

 

ACT2 website: www.act2drama.co.uk

Spotlight: www.spotlight.com

 

BOOKS ARE OPEN — APPLY NOW

items.text: Episode 49 of Beyond Reel Talk podcast with Rashaana Shah. She is an actor and producer with experience in Hollywood and Bollywood. In this episode, we discuss her exciting but also challenging journey, from the moment she ran away from her traditional Indian home to pursue a career in cinema. We talk about the differences between Hollywood and Bollywood, the struggles of independent filmmaking, and Rashaana’s desire to tell real and complicated stories like Line of Control. We also touch on the hardest parts of producing, motivation, rejection, sacrifices, and working with the amazing Danny Trejo.

VANCOUVER CASTING CALL — TWO FEMALE ROLES
We’re seeking two performers who can portray teenage girls, ages 13–19, for an independent short film exploring social issues affecting women. Adults who can convincingly play teens are welcome to apply.

Role 1: Open to all ethnicities

Role 2: Seeking an Indigenous performer

We’re looking for a natural presence and emotional depth. No acting experience or demo reel is required. Please send a short, makeup-free video introducing yourself.

Location: Vancouver

Filming: Two days in early November

Compensation: Unpaid portfolio project. Meals provided on both days.

The film is led by a female director, with a crew of Vancouver Film School graduates currently working in the industry. The director’s previous short received selections and awards across four film festivals in London and the United States. We plan to submit this film to more than 50 festivals.

Please send your introduction video and availability to hiayj23@gmail.com.

Thank you for your interest. Sharing this casting call is appreciated.

Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?

“Saving the Timothy” — A Modern Retelling of “A Christmas Carol”

The Recovered Arts Collective is seeking actors for an upcoming staged reading of Saving the Timothy, a new dramatic comedy written and directed by John-David Hutchison.

We also require Stage Manager, Assistant Director, Lighting & Sound Technicians

About the Project
We are bringing together a community of people with lived experience of addiction to participate in developing this new play. This project will culminate in a staged reading—a live performance where actors read the script with minimal sets, props, or costumes. Performers focus on character development, vocal expression, and text interpretation in a supportive, low-pressure environment.

Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the specter of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward 12-step redemption and sobriety.

Who Can Join & What to Expect
Inclusive Community: Everyone is welcome! Whether you are a seasoned creative or have never stepped foot on a stage before, no previous experience is required—just a willingness to share your story and connect.

Supportive Environment: A peer-led space focused on safety, creative expression, personal growth, and building lasting relationships.

Collaborative Process: Work together to bring personal and community stories to life, culminating in a public staged reading performance.

Key Dates & Location
Audition / Table Read: Sunday, November 1, 2026, 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Rehearsals: Sundays (November 8, 15, 22, 29), 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Performance: Sunday, December 6, 2026 (Time TBD)
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Character Breakdown
Eban Miser: A once-prominent Broadway and Hollywood director who, after facing bankruptcy, career failure, and struggles with alcoholism and drug addiction, returns to his hometown to direct a local production of A Christmas Carol and undergoes a redemptive journey toward sobriety.

Jake O'Connor/The Ghost of Christmas Future: Eban's late business partner and co-founder of the Timothy Findley Theatre, who dies broke and unaccomplished, but happy and whose reanimated corpse warns Eban to change his destructive path.

Bob Cratchit: Eban's loyal and hardworking stage manager at the theatre, who later becomes an equal partner and helps care for Timothia.

Fred: Eban's cheerful and persistent nephew who repeatedly invites him to holiday gatherings and tries to show him goodwill.

Clara: Fred's wife and member of the theatre troupe

Bill (The Ghost of Christmas Past): A calm, guiding figure who leads Eban through his spectral journey 

Fan: Eban's late sister.

Mr. Fezziwig: Eban's enthusiastic high school gym teacher who features in his past memory of a school dance.

Patricia: Eban's former fiancée who broke off their relationship because he abandoned their shared values for the pursuit of wealth.

Belle: Eban's former partner who left him because of his unaddressed alcoholism.

Emily: Bob Cratchit's sharp-tongued wife who helps run the household and cares for Timothia.

Timothia: Jake’s sullen 15-year-old orphaned daughter who lives with Bob and Emily.

Jack: The abusive stepfather from Eban's childhood.

Craig: Belle's husband.

Nancy, Topper, and Friends: Members of the theatre troupe
Roastmaster and 3 Roast Comics: Roasters of Eban (These four roles are specifically for comedians who will assist in the writing of the roast dialogue.)

This is a volunteer opportunity and you must be committed to the rehearsal schedule.

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Casting selection will be through the table read.

Questions? Reach out to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org with the subject line "Staged Reading Inquiry."

**ACTORS & PERFORMERS — FLEXIBLE PART-TIME JOB!**

**Hourly pay (+bonuses) | West Los Angeles | Flexible Weekday Hours**

Love meeting new people? Great at memorizing scripts, delivering a message naturally, and thinking on your feet?

We're a physician-led medical clinic looking for an outgoing, confident **Community Outreach/ Physician Liaison **

**What you'll do:**
* Learn and deliver short, conversational scripts introducing our clinic.
* Visit local physician offices and meet new people every day.
* Build relationships and make a great first impression.
* Think on your feet, handle different personalities, and adapt to each conversation.
* Listen to feedback and help us improve the patient referral experience.

**You're a great fit if you:**
* Love talking to people and aren't afraid to approach strangers.
* Can memorize a script and deliver it naturally and convincingly.
* Are charismatic, personable, and a great listener.
* Are comfortable with rejection and can stay positive.
* Have a reliable car and can work weekday hours.

Great opportunity for actors, performers, theater students, and anyone who enjoys connecting with people.

Interested? Email us at hello@infinitywellnessmd.com

🎬 CZEŚĆ WARSZAWO! SZUKAM IMPREZOWICZÓW! 🎉
Na plan reklamy jednej z platform sprzedażowych szukam statystów w wieku 17–25 lat do roli imprezowiczów.

Osoby powyżej 20. roku życia muszą wyglądać na maksymalnie 20 lat.

📅 Zdjęcia: 25.10 lub 26.10

To nie jest kontynuacja — w zgłoszeniu podajcie datę lub obie daty, w których jesteście dostępni.

⏰ Godziny nie są jeszcze znane, a plan może rozpocząć się wcześnie rano. Wymagana pełna dyspozycyjność w zgłaszanym dniu.

💰 Stawka: 140 zł, płatne przelewem.

W przypadku wykorzystania wizerunku przewidziana jest dopłata.

📲 Zgłoszenia wysyłajcie na numer: 797 169 069

Z dopiskiem „IMPREZOWICZ + data”.

W zgłoszeniu proszę zawrzeć:

• imię i nazwisko,

• wiek,

• wyraźne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki.

❗ Pod uwagę będą brane tylko kompletne zgłoszenia.

📩 Na zgłoszenia czekam do 22.10 do godz. 19:00.

Do wybranych osób odezwę się do końca dnia 23.10.

Marta 🎬 Filmakcja

Dobrego dnia! 😀

Hi everyone! I am casting a fantasy film in Los Angeles in November. We’re looking for background talent, and particularly wanted to open it up to the ren faire/cosplay/LARP communities as a forum to showcase talent and designs. If you are not part of one of these communities, that is fine and we would still love to have you! Please fill out the below Google form if you’re interested! 

There is more information about the team and project on the form, as well as a section to ask any questions. By filling out this form, you are NOT consenting to anything, just expressing your interest for us to reach out to you. 

[https://forms.gle/ortjqVfGrH3hPbo19](https://forms.gle/ortjqVfGrH3hPbo19)

CASTING CALL — PICTURE PERFECT 
Independent Romantic Drama | Non-Union | Potential festival submission. 

A successful photographer dreams of building a family. A driven executive has built her life around independence. When they fall in love, their fears threaten the future they could share.

Filming in Chicago, Illinois
Projected filming: Early spring 2027
Leads: $400/day | Supporting: $300/day | Day-player $250/day
Travel and lodging covered
Submit by December 1, 2026

LEAD ROLES

ISAIAH —  African American Male, must portray ages 30–40.
A successful photographer with warmth, natural charm, and a deep desire for lasting love. Requires romantic chemistry and emotional range.

NAOMI — African American Female, must portray ages 30–40.
An accomplished executive whose professional confidence conceals a fear of emotional dependence. Requires strength, vulnerability, and natural romantic chemistry.

SUPPORTING ROLES
Ages listed are playing ranges.

• ROBERT — African American Male, late 50s–60s. Isaiah’s affectionate, quietly humorous father. A widower with a rich inner life and a powerful emotional scene.

• VIVIAN — African American Female, late 50s–60s. Naomi’s polished, protective mother, rediscovering herself after an unhappy marriage.

• LEAH — African American Female, late 20s–early 30s. A sweet, personable grocery-store employee with a shy, playful side.

• MONICA — African American Female, late 20s–mid 30s. Seeking answers after being ghosted. A small role requiring emotional depth and believable vulnerability.

• TASHA — African American Female, late 20s–early 30s. Bold, flirtatious, and playful.

• ALICIA — Latina  Female, early–mid 30s. Navigating a complicated breakup, with warmth and vulnerability beneath her frustration.

• MAYA — Female, adult. Isaiah’s capable studio assistant. Observant, supportive, and naturally funny.

• ELLIS — Adult, any gender. Naomi’s efficient assistant. Professional presence with understated humor.

INTIMACY NOTES
Lead roles involve kissing and implied intimacy. Supporting roles involving intimacy require implied intimacy only—no kissing. Requirements will be discussed before casting.

TO SUBMIT
picperfect2027@gmail.com

Subject: PICTURE PERFECT — [ROLE] — [YOUR NAME]

Include:

• Headshot and recent photo
• Acting résumé
• Reel or performance clip, if available
• Current city and contact information
• Spring 2027 availability
• Role(s) you’re submitting for

Additional background and brief speaking opportunities will be announced separately.

Share with an actor who would be a great fit!

#PicturePerfectFilm #CastingCall #ChicagoActors #ActorsWanted #PaidCasting #IndependentFilm #NonUnion

Hi everyone! I’m Anne, an actor based on the Westside of LA , and I’m looking to connect and find more acting and production work.

**Acting:** I’m non-union and working toward my SAG-AFTRA eligibility, so I’d love to hear about any union background calls or voucher opportunities. I’m also open to non-union film, TV, commercials, student films and short films. 

I’ve trained with Actor’s Edge, Holly Gagnier and Aaron Metchik, and I’m currently repped (rep info available on request).

5'4" | Southeast Asian | Brown eyes | Plays 18–30
Hair: currently blonde (naturally black) and open to color or length changes for a role

**Production: **I’m also looking for PA work, set or office. I’ve worked on LA sets doing background, so I know my way around set etiquette, and I have an office admin background (scheduling, phones, document control) plus years of fast-paced bartending and serving. I have a valid license and my own car.

I also create brand content (UGC) for companies like YSL Beauty, Rare Beauty, McDonald’s and Shake Shack, so I’m comfortable on camera and quick with self tapes.

Happy to send headshots, a resume or a self-tape, so feel free to message me. I’m grateful for the space to share, and I’d love to support anyone else here too. Nice to meet you all!😁
